_comment: WHO the quorum gate BLOCKS, and who it merely advises.
The methodology is the maintainers' practice, not a tax on anyone who sends a
patch. A drive-by contributor does not have a 7-lane agent stack and must not be
blocked for that. They still SEE every finding -- the checks all run -- the gate
just does not refuse their push.
WHY IDENTITY AND NOT AN ENV VAR. An env-var bypass (QUORUM_SKIP=1) is available
to everyone including the people it is meant to bind, leaves no record, and is
invisible in review. Within a month it becomes the way everyone pushes and the
gate is decoration. Scoping by identity means someone in `enforced_for` can only
opt out by editing THIS FILE -- which lands in the PR diff, where a reviewer sees
it -- or by `git push --no-verify`, which is local-only and sits in the reflog.
The CI escape for an enforced author is `waived` in the receipt: a reason string,
committed, permanent, and reviewable. Bypass exists; silent bypass does not.
